## Resource types

### <a name="echo"></a>`echo`

The message is logged when the agent reaches the resource during the run,
so relationships, tags, schedules and failed dependencies apply to it as
they do to any other resource. The resource never reports a change.

#### Examples

##### Log the title

```puppet
echo { 'This node still uses the legacy profile': }
```

##### Log a separate message as a warning, without the resource path

```puppet
echo { 'legacy-profile':
  message  => 'This node still uses the legacy profile',
  loglevel => warning,
  withpath => false,
}
```

##### Log only when another resource changes

```puppet
echo { 'The application was redeployed':
  refreshonly => true,
  subscribe   => Package['myapp'],
}
```

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `echo` type.

* [`loglevel`](#-echo--loglevel)
* [`message`](#-echo--message)
* [`name`](#-echo--name)
* [`refreshonly`](#-echo--refreshonly)
* [`withpath`](#-echo--withpath)

##### <a name="-echo--loglevel"></a>`loglevel`

Valid values: `debug`, `info`, `notice`, `warning`, `err`, `alert`, `emerg`, `crit`

The log level to log the message at.

Default value: `notice`

##### <a name="-echo--message"></a>`message`

The message to log. A Sensitive value is logged as `Sensitive [value redacted]`.

##### <a name="-echo--name"></a>`name`

namevar

The name of the resource. It is logged as the message when `message` is not set.

##### <a name="-echo--refreshonly"></a>`refreshonly`

Valid values: `true`, `false`

Whether to log the message only when the resource receives a refresh.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-echo--withpath"></a>`withpath`

Valid values: `true`, `false`

Whether to prefix the message with the resource path.

Default value: `true`
